name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: First stable 1.0 release: settings UI polish, and federated downloads to this server are temporarily paused. The federation settings page's hero banner drops its gradient for a flat surface, tabs get more breathing room, and the 'cloud badge' setting is now an explicit Add/Remove button pair instead of a checkbox. Separately: downloading federated content onto this server is temporarily disabled while that flow is reworked - the item action-sheet's 'Download to server', the Browse tab's per-item Download button, and the prefer-higher-quality review's 'download better copy and remove old copy' action now all clearly show as disabled instead of running. Cancelling a download already in flight, and a viewer's own 'download to device' copy, are both unaffected. 347 tests, all green.
